map.依据痰涂片、培养及一线/二线药敏结果，分析耐药结核类型并提示治疗方案方向: Analyzes the drug-resistant TB type from sputum smear, culture and first/second-line susceptibility results, and indicates treatment direction
map.📖 查看「结核涂片培养耐药分析器 使用指南」: 📖 View the TB Smear/Culture Drug Resistance Analyzer user guide
map.结核耐药分型：无利福平及异烟肼耐药为药物敏感结核 DS-TB（2HRZE/4HR: TB resistance typing: no rifampicin or isoniazid resistance is drug-susceptible TB (DS-TB, 2HRZE/4HR); rifampicin resistance is RR-TB; with isoniazid resistance too it is MDR-TB; plus fluoroquinolone and second-line injectable resistance is XDR-TB - the regimen follows the resistance pattern.
map.至少耐INH+RIF: Resistant to at least INH + RIF
map.含贝达喹啉的短程或长程方案: Short or long regimen including bedaquiline
map.MDR/RR + 耐氟喹诺酮 或 二线注射剂: MDR/RR plus fluoroquinolone or second-line injectable resistance
map.MDR/RR + 耐氟喹诺酮 + 耐至少一种二线注射剂: MDR/RR plus fluoroquinolone resistance plus resistance to at least one second-line injectable
map.个体化长程方案，多学科会诊: Individualized long regimen with multidisciplinary review
map.提示：涂片阳性提示传染性强，需呼吸道隔离。GeneXpert利福平耐药需经表型药: Note: smear positivity indicates high infectivity and requires respiratory isolation. GeneXpert rifampicin resistance must be confirmed by phenotypic susceptibility. BPaL/BPaLM (bedaquiline + pretomanid + linezolid +/- moxifloxacin) suits MDR/RR-TB patients aged >=6 without fluoroquinolone or injectable resistance. Clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：结核耐药分析: 📚 Deep Dive: TB Drug Resistance Analysis
map.涂片阳性且有传染；Xpert 报利福平耐药→RR-TB，按耐药流程隔离治疗。: Smear positive and infectious; Xpert reports rifampicin resistance -> RR-TB, isolate and treat per the drug-resistant pathway.
map.涂片阴性+培养阴性→传染性低，仍完成疗程并复查。: Smear negative + culture negative -> low infectivity, but still complete the course and recheck.
map.RR-TB 指利福平耐药（无论异烟肼是否耐药）；若同时耐异烟肼即为 MDR-TB: RR-TB means rifampicin resistance (regardless of isoniazid); resistance to isoniazid as well defines MDR-TB. WHO 2021 defines MDR/RR plus fluoroquinolone resistance as pre-XDR, and additional bedaquiline or linezolid resistance as XDR.
map.涂片阴转并治疗 2 周后传染性大幅下降，遵医嘱解隔。: After smear conversion and 2 weeks of treatment infectivity drops sharply; de-isolate per medical advice.
map.关于「结核(涂片培养)耐药分析器」: About the TB (Smear/Culture) Drug Resistance Analyzer
map.结核(涂片培养)耐药分析器，依据痰涂片、培养及药敏结果分析结核分枝杆菌耐药情况(: TB (Smear/Culture) Drug Resistance Analyzer analyzes M. tuberculosis resistance (RR-TB / MDR-TB / XDR-TB) from smear, culture and susceptibility results, and guides regimen choice. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.请选择痰涂片、培养与 GeneXpert 结果后再行判读；空值不给出耐药分型。: Select smear, culture and GeneXpert results before interpreting; blanks yield no resistance classification.
map.无细菌学证据（涂片阴性、培养非阳性、GeneXpert 阴性或未做），不能据此给: No bacteriological evidence (negative smear, non-positive culture, negative or unperformed GeneXpert): no resistance classification or regimen can be given. Integrate symptoms, imaging and repeat microbiology, and obtain TB specialist review.
map.利福平耐药 + 耐贝达喹啉或利奈唑胺，氟喹诺酮仍敏感；尚未达到 XDR 定义。: Rifampicin resistance plus resistance to bedaquiline or linezolid with a still-susceptible fluoroquinolone; does not yet meet the XDR definition.
map.个体化方案，保留氟喹诺酮并联合其他有效药物，避免沿用含贝达喹啉/利奈唑胺的短程方: Individualized regimen retaining a fluoroquinolone plus other effective drugs; avoid short-course regimens containing bedaquiline/linezolid.
map.按RR-TB处理，采用含贝达喹啉的短程或长程方案；异烟肼是否保留按药敏与方案由专: Manage as RR-TB with a bedaquiline-containing short- or long-course regimen; whether to retain isoniazid is decided by susceptibility and specialist review.
map.耐药，所选方案须避免含该药，并按药敏联合有效药物。: resistance; the regimen must avoid that drug and combine effective agents per susceptibility.
map.GeneXpert 利福平耐药为分子预测，需培养/表型药敏确认；确认前按 RR-: GeneXpert rifampicin resistance is a molecular prediction and requires culture/phenotypic confirmation; manage as RR-TB with precautions until confirmed.
map.GeneXpert 提示利福平敏感，但药敏勾选利福平耐药，请核对结果来源并由实验: GeneXpert indicates rifampicin susceptibility but the susceptibility box is marked resistant; verify the source and obtain laboratory review.
map.分型依据 WHO 2021 耐药结核定义；方案需结核专科医师/药师结合药敏、肝肾: Classification follows the WHO 2021 drug-resistant TB definitions; the regimen requires TB specialist/ pharmacist review of susceptibility, hepatic/renal function and interactions.
map.提示：涂片阳性提示传染性强，需呼吸道隔离。GeneXpert 利福平耐药需经表型: Note: a positive smear indicates high infectivity and requires respiratory isolation. GeneXpert rifampicin resistance needs phenotypic confirmation. BPaL/BPaLM (bedaquiline + pretomanid + linezolid ± moxifloxacin) applies to eligible MDR/RR-TB (WHO 2022 rapid communication): BPaLM requires fluoroquinolone susceptibility, while fluoroquinolone-resistant cases may use BPaL without moxifloxacin; age and other eligibility criteria apply and TB specialist review is required. For clinical reference only; clinical review required.
